headline: ALMT Legal, Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas, Rajani Associates act on Bodycraft ₹120 crore fundraise
sum: Bodycraft Salon Skin and Cosmetology Pvt. Ltd.
detail: Bodycraft Salon Skin and Cosmetology Pvt. Ltd. has raised ₹120 crore from private equity firm Singularity AMC. ALMT Legal, Bangalore advised Bodycraft and its promoters on the transaction.
